premise.premise: A child sets one small goal for the new school term and finds a clever way to practise a little every day.

item.title: Dan's New Words
item.passage: Dan wants to learn five new words every day. He writes his new words on green paper. His floor is dirty today. Dan puts the green paper on his desk so it is clean. Dan likes to learn when he eats breakfast. He reads his paper in the morning because he eats his food then. He says all five words out loud. Dan smiles because he knows every word now.

item.title: Dan and His Guitar
item.passage: Dan loved his new music hobby. He wanted to practise every day because he wanted to play for his friends. Dan put his guitar by his bed so he saw it before bed. Every night, he sat down and played a sweet song. His friends listened and clapped for him. Dan smiled because he was happy with his music. He enjoyed playing every day.
